[[File:The_Omnicannon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Omnicannon]]
The '''Omnicannon''' was a powerful weapon that was the primary weapon of the [[Gravestone]], an ancient and alien combat [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]]. Through the Omnicannon, the Gravestone was the only [[Starship/Legends|starship]] capable of battling the [[Eternal Fleet]]; the Omnicannon fired shots that propagated outward after hitting from its primary target, spreading damage to nearby ships. [[Alliance Commander|The Outlander's]] group's first use of the Omnicannon took out two dozen ships in a single shot. Another omnicannon was also used by the machine [[God/Legends|god]] [[Izax]] during his fight with the Outlander and a strike team, again used to fight the Eternal Fleet - now under control of the Outlander - but was interrupted by the strike team and [[Scyva]] before his demise.
